note: Triennial election of Newry No. 2 (County Armagh) Rural District Council, twenty-nine single-member divisions, 1949. Nominations were received by W. B. O'Donoghue, returning officer; five contests were threatened but four took place, polled Thursday 2 June 1949. There was no nomination for Drumintee, whose outgoing member was deemed re-elected. Labels as printed in the Newry Telegraph. Division printed "Dorsey". Differs from the published round: the published round reads 'Peter J. Carragher'; the nominations list prints 'Peter J. Caraher'. Returned unopposed. The County Armagh transcription published before 7 Nov 2026 (Newry Telegraph, 21 May 1949, p. 3 ("Newry No. 2 (Co. Armagh) Rural District Council")) read Peter J. Caraher: 'Peter J. Carragher', label 'AP'.
